jobDescription:
Executive Assistant to CEO Business Development, AI & International Engagement

Location: Bangalore
Experience: 5-10 years preferred
Employment Type: Full-time
Travel: Frequent national and international travel

About the Role

We are looking for a highly articulate, confident, commercially minded and tech-savvy Executive Assistant to the CEO who can operate well beyond the traditional Executive Assistant role.

This is not an administrative or calendar-management position.

The ideal candidate will be a trusted extension of the CEO in business interactions and should possess the relationship-building ability, confidence and commercial instincts of a strong business-development professional, combined with the organization, discretion and judgment expected from an Executive Assistant.

The role involves significant interaction with customers, prospects, partners, senior executives and international business contacts, including accompanying the CEO to customer meetings, conferences, exhibitions and business events in India and overseas.

The candidate should also be AI-native, comfortable using Generative AI and modern digital tools to improve research, communication, presentations, content creation and executive productivity.

Key Responsibilities

1. CEO & Executive Office Support

  • Work closely with the CEO on business priorities, strategic initiatives and important engagements.
  • Prepare the CEO for customer meetings, conferences, presentations and business discussions.
  • Conduct research on customers, prospects, industries, competitors and events.
  • Prepare executive briefing notes, presentations, meeting summaries and business documents.
  • Track important discussions, opportunities, commitments and follow-ups.
  • Coordinate with internal teams to ensure timely execution of CEO-driven initiatives.
  • Handle sensitive and confidential information with a high degree of discretion and professionalism.

2. Customer Engagement & Business Development

This is a highly relationship-oriented role.

The candidate should be comfortable acting as an extension of the CEO in customer and business-development situations.

Responsibilities include:

  • Accompanying the CEO to customer meetings and business discussions.
  • Building rapport with customers, prospects, partners and senior executives.
  • Initiating conversations and confidently networking with people not previously known to the candidate.
  • Understanding customer requirements and identifying potential business opportunities.
  • Supporting lead generation and relationship development.
  • Following up with prospects and contacts after meetings and events.
  • Maintaining professional relationships and developing a strong business network.
  • Identifying relevant opportunities, introductions, events and connections that could benefit the company.

A natural sales personality and the ability to influence and build relationships will be highly valued.

3. Conferences, Events & International Engagement

The candidate should be comfortable representing the company alongside the CEO at:

  • International and national conferences
  • Technology and AI events
  • Trade shows and exhibitions
  • Customer meetings
  • Partner meetings
  • Business networking events
  • Industry forums

You should be comfortable walking into an unfamiliar environment, introducing yourself, starting conversations, understanding people quickly and building meaningful professional relationships.

Frequent travel within India and internationally is an integral part of this position.

4. AI & Digital Technology

A strong interest and practical knowledge of Artificial Intelligence and Generative AI is an important requirement.

The candidate should be comfortable using tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and other emerging AI platforms for:

  • Business and customer research
  • Information analysis
  • Content creation
  • Presentation development
  • Business communication
  • Executive productivity
  • Idea generation and brainstorming
  • Workflow improvement and automation

Experience with AI-powered image and video generation, video editing, presentation creation or digital-content production will be an additional advantage.

We are particularly interested in candidates who actively experiment with AI and continuously discover new ways to use technology to work smarter and faster.

5. Communication & Executive Presence

The candidate must have exceptional interpersonal and communication skills.

You should be:

  • Highly articulate and fluent in English.
  • Confident communicating with senior executives and customers.
  • An excellent conversationalist and active listener.
  • Comfortable presenting ideas and information.
  • Persuasive without being aggressive.
  • Professionally groomed and polished.
  • Comfortable in formal business environments as well as informal networking situations.
  • Capable of representing the CEO and company with maturity and professionalism.
  • Sensitive to cultural differences when dealing with international customers and partners.

6. Foreign Language Skills

Knowledge of a foreign language will be a significant advantage.

Spanish language proficiency will receive particular preference, especially conversational or professional-level Spanish.

Knowledge of Portuguese, French or other international business languages will also be considered an advantage.

Who We Are Looking For

We are looking for someone who is:

  • Commercially minded and business-oriented
  • Confident and highly presentable
  • Smart, resourceful and highly observant
  • Strong in interpersonal and relationship-building skills
  • Naturally outgoing and comfortable meeting new people
  • Comfortable initiating conversations and networking
  • Able to read people and situations quickly
  • Able to think on her feet and handle unexpected situations
  • Proactive rather than dependent on instructions
  • Highly organized and detail-oriented
  • Comfortable interacting with senior executives
  • Tech-savvy and genuinely interested in AI
  • A fast learner who embraces new technologies
  • Comfortable with frequent national and international travel
  • Discreet, trustworthy and capable of handling confidential information
  • Mature enough to operate independently in high-level business environments

Most importantly:

You should be someone who makes things happen.

We are not looking for someone who simply waits for instructions or manages a calendar. We want someone who sees an opportunity, takes initiative, starts the conversation, builds the relationship and follows through.

Preferred Background

Candidates with experience in one or more of the following areas will be particularly relevant:

  • Executive Assistant to a CEO / Founder
  • Business Development
  • Sales
  • Client / Relationship Management
  • Corporate Communications
  • Technology / IT
  • AI / Digital Technology
  • Consulting
  • Events & Conferences
  • International Business
  • Luxury Hospitality
  • Aviation / Travel
  • PR / Media

A combination of Executive Assistant + Business Development/Sales + Technology/AI exposure would be ideal.

What This Role Is NOT

This is not a traditional Administrative Assistant or Executive Assistant role focused primarily on:

  • Calendar management
  • Appointment scheduling
  • Routine administrative work
  • Filing and documentation
  • Office administration

These responsibilities may occasionally be required, but they are not the core purpose of this position.

The core purpose is to help the CEO build relationships, develop business opportunities, represent the company, engage with customers and leverage technology to operate more effectively.

Why This Role Is Different

This position provides direct exposure to:

  • The CEO and company leadership
  • International customers and business partners
  • Global conferences and industry events
  • Business development and sales
  • Artificial Intelligence and emerging technologies
  • International business environments
  • Strategic business discussions

This is an opportunity for someone who wants to develop into a high-impact business professional, rather than remain in a purely administrative career path.

The ideal candidate is:

Articulate | Commercially Smart | Confident | Presentable | Tech-Savvy | AI-Native | Persuasive | Proactive | Well-Connected | Resourceful | Internationally Mobile

If you are someone who can represent the CEO confidently, connect with people, identify opportunities, leverage AI and make things happen we would like to hear from you.

    • Design and develop scalable web applications using Django (backend) and React (frontend)

    • Maintain and enhance existing applications
    • Stay up to date with modern development practices and technologies

    • You are organised and a fast learner

Skills, knowledge and experience:

  • Core Engineering
    • Strong proficiency in Python
    • Strong experience with Django (or similar backend frameworks)
    • Strong experience with React
    • Experience building and consuming RESTful APIs
    • Solid understanding of full stack architecture
  • Frontend
    • Strong knowledge of JavaScript, HTML, and CSS
    • Experience with modern frontend tooling and frameworks
    • Understanding of responsive design principles

    • Experience with relational databases (e.g. PostgreSQL, MySQL)
    • Understanding of ORM frameworks (Django ORM preferred)
    • Experience designing efficient data models
  • Cloud & DevOps
    • Familiarity with cloud platforms such as Google, AWS, or Azure
    • Experience with deployment, CI/CD pipelines, and version control (Git)
  • Best Practices
    • Knowledge of security and data protection best practices
    • Writing clean, maintainable, and testable code
    • Experience debugging and troubleshooting production issues

title: Digital Product Manager
jobDescription:
Job Summary

Let's do this. Let's change the world!

In this vital role, the L5 Product Owner / Scrum Master will serve as the primary Product Owner and Agile delivery lead for the India-based AIN team supporting the SAGE program. The role combines hands-on backlog ownership and requirement clarification with Scrum Master facilitation, delivery leadership, and Agile coaching to enable clear priorities, predictable execution, and high-quality outcomes.

Working across business, product, engineering, architecture, data science, QA, and leadership, the role will translate business and technical priorities into actionable work, maintain stakeholder alignment, remove impediments, coordinate dependencies, and strengthen the team's ways of working.

Responsibilities Product Ownership Backlog
  • Own and maintain the AIN team backlog, including prioritization, user stories, acceptance criteria, dependencies, and development readiness.
  • Translate business and technical priorities into actionable work and align sprint goals and delivery commitments to business outcomes.
  • Serve as the bridge between business and technology, clarifying ambiguous requirements and communicating complex technical topics in business terms.
Agile Delivery Team Effectiveness
  • Facilitate sprint planning, daily stand-ups, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, retrospectives, release planning, and PI/quarterly planning as applicable.
  • Remove impediments, manage risks and cross-team dependencies, and coordinate across global teams and time zones to keep delivery moving.
  • Coach the team on Agile and SAFe practices, accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and effective ways of working.
Flow, Metrics Continuous Improvement
  • Improve flow and predictability by managing work in progress, spillover, capacity, bottlenecks, and delivery dependencies.
  • Use metrics such as velocity, burndown, sprint goal attainment, cycle time, throughput, and predictability to improve transparency and decision-making.
  • Drive actionable retrospectives and follow through on improvement opportunities across sprints.
Release Stakeholder Coordination
  • Support release planning, UAT coordination, production readiness, and stakeholder communications, ensuring risks, quality, dependencies, and operational readiness are addressed.
  • Maintain clear visibility into priorities, progress, blockers, decisions, and expected outcomes for business and technical stakeholders.
Success in This Role

Success will be measured by the ability to enable a predictable, transparent, high-performing AIN team that consistently delivers meaningful business outcomes for SAGE.

Indicators of success include:

  • The AIN backlog is well-groomed, prioritized, actionable, and ready for execution.
  • User stories and acceptance criteria provide sufficient clarity for development and testing.
  • Sprint ceremonies are effective, consistent, and outcome-focused.
  • Sprint goals and delivery commitments are clear and aligned to business priorities.
  • Delivery risks, dependencies, and blockers are identified and addressed early.
  • Work progresses through the delivery lifecycle with reduced friction and unnecessary spillover.
  • Stakeholders have clear visibility into team priorities, progress, risks, and expected outcomes.
  • Releases, UAT activities, and production readiness are effectively coordinated.
  • The team delivers predictable, high-quality outcomes.
  • Agile metrics are used effectively to improve flow, quality, transparency, and decision-making.
  • Continuous-improvement actions are identified, implemented, and measured across sprints.
  • The team demonstrates increasing accountability, collaboration, and delivery effectiveness.
Qualifications Basic Qualifications
  • Masters degree OR Bachelors degree with 812 years of experience in Information Systems, Engineering, or related fields.
  • Experience in Agile delivery roles such as Product Owner, Scrum Master, Agile Coach, Business Analyst, or similar.
  • Strong understanding of Agile/Scrum practices and software delivery lifecycles.
  • Experience working with engineering, QA, product, business, and other cross-functional teams.
  • Experience managing priorities, delivery risks, dependencies, and stakeholder expectations.
  • Experience working with globally distributed teams and across multiple time zones.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Technical thought leadership.
  • Ability to communicate technical or complex subject matters in business terms.
  • Experience writing and refining user stories, acceptance criteria, requirements, and product backlogs.
  • Jira Align experience.
  • Miro experience.
  • Workshop facilitation experience.
  • Experience working with India-based delivery teams.
  • Experience supporting enterprise platforms, digital products, analytics initiatives, data products, AI-enabled solutions, or large-scale transformation programs.
  • Familiarity with Agentic AI, Databricks, or related data and development technologies.
  • Experience supporting pharmaceutical, biotechnology, healthcare, or other regulated-industry environments.
  • Experience supporting organizational change and digital transformation initiatives.
Skills Must-Have
  • Strong expertise in Agile methodologies, especially SAFe.
  • Demonstrated experience balancing Product Owner and Agile delivery responsibilities.
  • Strong backlog-management skills, including prioritization, story refinement, acceptance criteria, dependency management, and development readiness.
  • Experience with tools such as Jira, Confluence, and Jira Align.
  • Proven ability to facilitate Agile ceremonies and ensure adherence to effective Agile practices.
  • Strong understanding of sprint planning, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, retrospectives, and scaled planning activities.
  • Experience using Agile and delivery metrics to improve team execution, flow, and predictability.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills with a data-driven mindset.
  • Excellent collaboration and stakeholder-management skills.
  • Strong dependency, risk, and impediment-management capabilities.
  • Ability to influence without authority across global and matrixed organizations.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Good-to-Have
  • Understanding of DevOps and Test Automation pipelines.
  • Experience facilitating workshops and Agile training sessions.
  • Familiarity with data platforms and ETL pipelines.
  • Familiarity with AI, analytics, data products, Agentic AI, or Databricks environments.
  • Experience with Kanban and flow-based delivery practices.
  • Experience supporting Program Increment planning and Agile Release Train activities.
  • Understanding of product management, portfolio management, and roadmap-alignment practices.
Certifications Preferred
  • Certified SAFe Scrum Master (SSM) or equivalent.
  • SAFe Release Train Engineer (RTE) or equivalent.
  • Certified ScrumMaster (CSM).
  • Professional Scrum Master (PSM).
  • Certified Product Owner or equivalent Product Owner certification.
  • PMI-ACP or other recognized Scrum / Agile certification.
Soft Skills
  • Strong leadership, facilitation, and coaching capabilities.
  • Excellent communication across business, scientific, and technical audiences.
  • Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear business language.
  • Ability to bring structure and clarity to ambiguous situations.
  • Strong influencing, negotiation, and conflict-resolution skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Organized, collaborative, proactive, and outcome-oriented working style.
  • Team-oriented mindset with a focus on outcomes and impact.
  • Ability to build trust and productive relationships across functions, geographies, and organizational levels.

Technical Product Manager Commercial Sales Technology AI

At FIS, our technology and our people are moving forward. We advance the way the world pays, banks and invests. We believe in building inclusive, diverse teams. Together, we innovate to help our colleagues, clients and communities succeed. If you're ready to grow your career and make an impact in fintech, we have one question: Are you FIS

What you will be doing

Are you ready to own the sales technology and AI infrastructure that powers a global commercial organization keeping it live, trusted, and embedded in the way sellers actually work

FIS is looking for a Technical Product Manager to join the Sales Technology AI team within Revenue Operations, Commercial Office. This is the role that takes ownership of a defined portfolio of seller-facing platforms and AI-enabled workflows not just configuring them, but governing, documenting, and driving adoption across a large, distributed commercial organization.

This is an individual contributor role with genuine hands-on ownership. You will not manage a team, you will own the operational detail that keeps critical systems running and adopted. You will administer platforms, configure AI agents, maintain renewal intelligence dashboards, and serve as the go-to expert for the commercial technology stack. The ideal candidate brings the technical fluency to own platform administration end-to-end, the communication skills to translate complexity into clear guidance for sellers, and the delivery instinct to follow through until the job is done not just planned.

What you will be doing Platform Ownership and Administration
  • Own the day-to-day administration of the commercial sales technology platforms Seismic (content enablement), Responsive and LinkedIn (seller intelligence) keeping them configured, governed and available for the field.
  • Own super-admin and administrator access, SSO configuration, user roles and access controls taking hands-on responsibility for the technical set-up and the business decisions around access, including clean transition and handover of these responsibilities.
  • Manage vendor and support interactions across the platform portfolio to keep systems running, resolve issues, and land upgrades and configuration changes on schedule.
  • Maintain clear documentation of configuration, access, ownership and support paths so the platforms are auditable, supportable, and never dependent on one person''s memory.
AI Agents and MCP Enablement
  • Own the business-side setup, documentation and adoption of commercial AI agents and copilots including the CIQ Training Agent, Sales Assistant Agent, FIS Procurement Assistant and Win/Loss Intelligence Advisor configuring, testing, rolling out and supporting them for everyday seller use.
  • Own the business context and operating model for MCP server integration with Seismic and Responsive defining, in clear business terms, how AI experiences connect to approved commercial systems and data.
  • Support in-flight pilots such as Othello.ai through use-case articulation, rollout planning, adoption tracking and success measurement.
  • Work with technical and security stakeholders to ensure integrations are set up correctly, and translate what they mean for users, support and ongoing ownership.
  • Sense-check new AI use cases for value, risk and adoption readiness before rollout so what ships is practical and actually used, not just technically possible.
Renewal and Retention Intelligence
  • Own and maintain the Global Client Retention renewal intelligence dashboards as a reliable, business-facing reporting capability that commercial teams can trust and act on.
  • Keep the data usable and accurate diagnose and fix issues as they arise, and improve dashboards based on how commercial teams actually use them in practice.
  • Translate dashboard output into clear, regular updates that drive commercial action rather than passive reporting.
Enablement, Technical Content and Adoption
  • Produce clear technical content and documentation configuration guides, playbooks, one-page summaries, process maps and user how-to material that sellers can pick up and use without hand-holding.
  • Lead practical rollout and adoption activity: communications, training materials, readiness checklists and feedback loops for platform launches, AI agent releases and dashboard changes.
  • Support global users by diagnosing friction points, simplifying workflows and answering the day-to-day questions that keep adoption high across NA, EMEA and APAC.
  • Maintain a clear view of what is owned here versus what sits with enterprise IT, and know when to escalate and how.
What you will need
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience administering enterprise sales technology or commercial platforms owning configuration, access management and day-to-day operation, not just advising on it.
  • Hands-on experience configuring SSO, super-admin / administrator access, user roles and access controls comfortable owning both the technical setup and the business decisions around access, including ownership transition.
  • Demonstrated ability to write clear technical content and documentation configuration guides, playbooks and user-facing how-to material that real users adopt.
  • Sufficient business understanding of integrations and MCP servers to own the business side, brief technical teams, and explain what they mean for users and support without jargon.
  • Practical, hands-on experience working with AI tools or agents in a business setting configuring, rolling out and supporting them for real users, not just evaluating them.
  • A strong bias for execution and delivery someone who owns the operational detail, follows through, and keeps systems running reliably. This is a role for a doer who enjoys ownership and getting things done well.
  • Comfort working independently in a global organization and moving work forward through influence rather than formal authority.
What you should have
  • Bachelor''s degree in Business, Information Technology, Computer Science or a related field.
  • Background in fintech, financial services, enterprise SaaS, revenue operations or commercial technology.
  • Experience with sales content, RFP / response management, seller-workflow platforms, commercial data tools or AI-enabled productivity tools.
  • Working knowledge of platform administration, access models, vendor management and basic security-review processes.
  • Experience creating adoption materials such as playbooks, one-page guides, process maps and training material that field teams actually use.
  • A practical view of how AI, automation and integrations reduce workflow friction when embedded in real work and kept simple and where they don''t.

Job Summary

Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human. Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

We are seeking an experienced and technically influential Senior Software Development Engineer to join our Cloud Tooling and Pipelines team. This pivotal team is responsible for the design, development, and maintenance of our core Continuous Delivery (CD) platform (leveraging Spinnaker and custom tooling), Infrastructure as Code (IaC) execution engines (primarily Terraform), and a suite of supporting microservices. These systems are critical for enabling and managing our extensive resource footprint across AWS ECS and EKS.

As a Senior Software Development Engineer, you will be a key contributor, driving the implementation of scalable, reliable, and secure software solutions that automate infrastructure provisioning and application deployments. Your deep expertise in software engineering principles and cloud-native development will be essential in building and enhancing our critical tooling for infrastructure provisioning, vulnerability management, and IaC deployments. You will also play a vital role in mentoring other engineers and influencing the team's technical roadmap. If you have a strong passion for building robust software systems that empower operational efficiency at scale, we encourage you to apply.

We are looking for a Senior Engineer to join the FGA Developer Tooling team and help evolve our end to end developer experience across both OSS and SaaS.
This team owns the SDKs in Go, JavaScript, .NET, Python, Java and other languages, along with CLI workflows, IDE integrations, GitHub automation, developer documentation, and release strategy.   • Implement advanced capabilities such as BatchCheck, ListRelations, and non transactional write operations with appropriate parallelization and performance considerations.
  • Contribute to the SDK generator tooling, templates, and supporting build workflows using Docker and related tooling.
  • Develop comprehensive tests for all exposed methods, including proper mocking of external requests.
  • Write and maintain clear developer focused documentation, guides, and examples.
  • Optimize and maintain CI workflows using GitHub Actions for building, testing, and releasing SDK clients.
  • Minimize external dependencies within SDKs, introducing new dependencies only when clearly justified.
  • Collaborate closely with FGA Core and other internal teams to ensure API changes are reflected cleanly and consistently across SDKs.
  • Participate actively in open source development, review community pull requests, and help contributors reach a mergeable state.
  • Participate in code reviews and post delivery validation to ensure high quality, secure SDK releases.
Requirements:
  • 5+ years of experience as a Software Engineer, ideally with experience building SDKs, libraries, or developer tooling.
  • Proficiency in at least one, and ideally multiple, of the following: Go, JavaScript or TypeScript, C# .NET, Python, or Java.
  • Solid understanding of SDK development principles, API ergonomics, and cross language design considerations.
  • Experience working with code generation tools such as OpenAPI Generator and templating systems.
  • Experience implementing authentication flows, retry logic, error handling, and managing client side parallelization.
  • Experience setting up and maintaining GitHub Actions and release workflows.
  • Strong testing practices including mocking external services and validating client behavior.
  • Good understanding of version control systems and familiarity with PR based development workflows.
  • Experience working in open source projects is a plus.
  • Strong problem solving skills and the ability to work independently while collaborating in a distributed, open development environment.

jobDescription:

Auth0 is an easy-to-implement, authentication and authorization platform designed by developers for developers. We make applicationslogin boxes safe, secure, and seamless for anyone logging in.

The Auth0 Data Engineering Team

Within Auth0, the Data Engineering team builds solutions to support analytics needs for the whole organization and is in charge of the Data Platform. It is divided into 3 groups:

  • Pipeline team, sitting closer to the Platform team and data producers and in charge of the efficient data ingestion and provision of quick access to unmodeled data
  • Warehouse team sitting closer to the business teams and data consumers and in charge of modeling the data in the data warehouse to abstract away the complexity for data consumers, simplifying the organizations analysis, reporting and decision-making
  • Interface team responsible for creating and managing connections between the data platform and various external systems (internal or external facing), making sure everyone has access to consistent and reliable data

The Senior Data Engineer Opportunity

Reporting to the manager of the Data Engineering Pipeline team, the senior data engineer will be a key player in ensuring the reliability and efficiency of our core data platform. This role is crucial, providing the stable data foundation that not only runs the business day-to-day but also directly empowers the organization to unlock growth and build innovative new products. We are looking for an autonomous and proactive engineer who can take ownership of our data ingestion pipelines, work closely with platform teams and data producers, and onboard new data from various internal and external systems. You will be part of a team creating robust, scalable data solutions using a modern, best-in-class toolset.

What youll be doing

  • Own and operate our critical data pipelines and infrastructure, participating in the team's support rotation to ensure high availability and business continuity.
  • Lead troubleshooting efforts to fix complex pipeline or infrastructure issues, demonstrating a willingness to go beyond the direct scope of the team to find resolutions.
  • Manage the data onboarding lifecycle, working with stakeholders to integrate new internal and external data sources into our platform using our suite of tools.
  • Develop and deploy robust, scalable data solutions using modern tools and technologies like Snowflake, dbt, Airflow, and Terraform.
  • Continuously learn and advocate for modern technologies and best practices to improve data delivery and engineering efficiency.

What youll bring to the role

  • 5+ years of software development experience, with at least 3+ years working on large-scale data systems.
  • Strong proficiency in SQL for data manipulation and Python for data pipeline development.
  • Hands-on experience building and operating data pipelines in a cloud environment (AWS preferred).
  • Hands-on experience with the modern data stack, specifically:
    • Data Warehousing: Snowflake
    • Data Transformation: dbt
    • Infrastructure as Code: Terraform
  • Experience with data ingestion, streaming, and event-driven architecture (e.g., Kafka, CDC, Snowpipe).
  • Knowledge of data security and data privacy best practices
  • A strong understanding of data modeling principles
  • A highly autonomous and proactive mindset. You are a quick learner who can self-motivate, prioritize needs, and deliver results in a dynamic environment.

And extra credit if you have experience in any of the following!

  • Experience with Snowpark.
  • Experience with containerization and orchestration (Kubernetes is a nice to have).
  • Familiarity with the Identity Access Management (IAM) domain.
  • Experience building developer-friendly, API-driven applications using REST and/or gRPC.

jobDescription:
Position Overview

Vodafone Idea is looking for a seasoned AI Architect to design, build, and scale enterprise-grade AI and Generative AI (GenAI) solutions. In this role, you will be responsible for defining the technical architecture and roadmap for AI applications deployed on top of our enterprise Cloudera Data Platform (CDP 7.1.9 / 7.3.1).

You will bridge the gap between complex big data ecosystems and cutting-edge machine learning/LLM workflows. The ideal candidate brings hands-on expertise in model selection, lifecycle governance, prompt engineering, and production-grade MLOps/AIOps integrated into modern DevOps pipelines.

Key Responsibilities

1. Enterprise AI & CDP Solution Architecture

  • Lead the end-to-end architecture and integration of Predictive AI and Generative AI applications built directly on CDP 7.1.9 / 7.3.1 infrastructure.
  • Design high-throughput, low-latency data pipelines and feature stores leveraging CDP components (Spark, Hive, Impala, Kafka, Apache Iceberg).
  • Establish retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) frameworks, fine-tuning setups, and vector search systems connected to enterprise big data repositories.

2. Model Selection, Implementation & Governance

  • Evaluate, benchmark, and select optimal foundational models (LLMs, SLMs, open-source vs. proprietary) and classic ML algorithms tailored for telecom use cases (e.g., customer churn, network optimization, hyper-personalization, fraud detection).
  • Enforce robust AI Governance frameworks covering model drift detection, explainability (XAI), fairness/bias mitigation, data privacy, and compliance.
  • Manage model registry, lifecycle versioning, and policy enforcement across dynamic runtime environments.

3. Prompt Engineering & GenAI Optimization

  • Establish standardized prompt engineering methodologies, context-window management, and agentic workflows (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, AutoGen).
  • Optimize token utilization, latency, throughput, and inference costs for LLM deployments.
  • Implement guardrails, output validation, and safety filters to prevent hallucination, data leakage, and security risks in public/private LLM interactions.

4. MLOps, AIOps & DevOps Integration

  • Design and implement robust MLOps/AIOps pipelines for automated model training, continuous integration, testing, deployment, and real-time monitoring (CI/CD/CT).
  • Partner with DevOps teams to deploy containerized AI microservices (Kubernetes, Docker) within hybrid-cloud and on-premises infrastructure.
  • Configure comprehensive telemetry, logging, and observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana, MLflow, Weights & Biases) to maintain continuous operational health.

Required Qualifications & Experience

  • Education: Bachelors or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a related quantitative field.
  • Experience: 10+ years in Data Science / Software Engineering, with at least 4+ years as an AI/ML Architect delivering enterprise scale systems.
  • Big Data Platform: Deep hands-on experience with Cloudera Data Platform (CDP 7.1.9 or CDP 7.3.1), PySpark, HDFS, and Hive/Impala.
  • AI & GenAI Expertise: Proven experience developing, fine-tuning, and deploying Large Language Models (LLMs), RAG architectures, multi-agent frameworks, and traditional supervised/unsupervised ML models.
  • MLOps & Governance: Strong experience with MLflow, Model Registry, feature stores, model drift monitoring, data lineage, and enterprise AI guardrails.
  • DevOps Tools: Proficiency with Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD tools (Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions), Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform, Ansible), and Git workflows.
  • Programming Languages: Advanced expertise in Python, PySpark, SQL, and bash scripting.
  • Frameworks & Libraries: PyTorch, TensorFlow, Hugging Face, LangChain, LlamaIndex, vLLM, Triton Server.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior experience in Telecom / Communication Service Provider (CSP) domain handling massive scale subscriber and event network data.

jobDescription:
AI Operations Incident Commander

Major Incident Management | Technical Coordination | Shift Leadership | Handoff Discipline

Purpose: Provide offshore incident command, lead live technical coordination during offshore hours, and maintain seamless incident continuity with the onshore lead.

Role

AI Operations Incident Commander (Offshore)

Level

Experienced / Senior

Tower

AI Operations & Platform Support (AI Managed Services)

Experience

6+ years in production operations, incident management, technical support leadership, or live service operations

Work Location

India (Bangalore / Hyderabad)

Key Platforms

AI support operations across AWS / Bedrock, OpenAI, platform and application support teams, ITSM workflows, and major-incident bridges

Role profile

Hands-on incident leader who can run the bridge, coordinate technical triage, maintain clean evidence trails, and keep incidents moving during offshore hours without waiting for others to create structure.

Primary focus

Live incident command, technical triage coordination, severity assessment, responder mobilization, handoff quality, ticket discipline, and restoration tracking.

Best fit

Someone who is calm, structured, operationally strong, and able to direct engineers and support teams while still staying close to the technical detail.

Role Summary

As the AI Operations Incident Commander (Offshore), you will lead live incident coordination during offshore hours and provide structured command for production issues impacting the clients AI support environment. We need someone who can rapidly size the situation, confirm severity, engage the right teams, keep the bridge disciplined, and maintain an accurate view of what is happening technically. This role sits close to the work: you should be comfortable coordinating engineers, reviewing evidence, challenging weak updates, and preparing clean handoffs to the onshore lead and client stakeholders when needed.

Key Responsibilities

1. Live incident command and technical coordination

  • Lead Severity 1, Severity 2, and priority production incidents during offshore coverage, including bridge setup, severity confirmation, responder coordination, action tracking, and restoration cadence.
  • Drive structured technical triage across SRE, platform, integration, application, service desk, security, and vendor teams so incidents continue moving and do not stall in ambiguity.
  • Maintain a current command view of symptoms, likely causes, actions in progress, risks, dependencies, and next decisions required.

2. Handoffs, escalation, and operational discipline

  • Prepare concise, high-quality handoffs to the onshore lead with clear incident status, unresolved risks, owners, timestamps, and recommended next actions.
  • Escalate early when severity, business impact, stakeholder sensitivity, or technical uncertainty requires broader engagement or onshore leadership attention.
  • Ensure ticket hygiene, bridge notes, timelines, and action logs are complete enough to support RCA, reporting, and clean follow-through.

3. Change risk, problem management, and improvement support

  • Support operational readiness for risky changes, releases, and maintenance activities by asking the right questions about rollback, validation, monitoring, and support readiness.
  • Contribute incident evidence and technical observations into post-incident reviews and corrective-action planning.
  • Identify repeat failure patterns, weak runbooks, and support-process gaps, then push improvements back into the service.

4. Stakeholder engagement and team ways of working

  • Work closely with the onshore incident lead, offshore engineers, resolver groups, vendors, and service leadership to keep decision-making and recovery aligned.
  • Engage stakeholders proactively to unblock work rather than waiting for direction when an incident is already live.
  • Create structure in fast-moving situations and help less experienced responders operate with clarity and confidence.

Preferred Skills and Experience

Skill area

Preferred background

Major incident leadership

Experience coordinating high-severity production incidents, including bridge management, severity assessment, action tracking, and restoration management.

Technical support depth

Enough technical depth to follow cloud, application, integration, and observability signals and challenge incomplete or weak technical updates.

Service operations and ITIL

Experience working within ITIL-aligned incident, problem, change, and service-request processes with strong ticket hygiene.

Communication and handoffs

Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to provide concise bridge updates and high-quality handoffs across shifts.

Problem solving under ambiguity

Ability to make sound decisions with incomplete information, prioritize quickly, and keep progress moving.

Ownership and teamwork

Strong sense of ownership, comfort operating in ambiguity, and willingness to engage stakeholde

Role Summary

We are looking for a detail-oriented and technically strong Engineer who thoroughly understands the shop-floor realities of custom equipment manufacturing. The ideal candidate will act as the bridge between engineering documentation, on-ground manufacturing and digital project execution.

Your core responsibility will be to read Production Drawings and ITPs/QAPs, and translate them into highly granular Manufacturing Schedules and Control Plans on the Venwiz platform. You must have a strong grasp of core manufacturing processes - specifically Welding, Casting, Forging, Machining and assembly - along with foundational Project Management principles.

Beyond technical scheduling, you will serve as the primary communication link with vendors- requiring excellent professional email etiquette, strong negotiation skills, and the ability to logically persuade vendors to meet critical deadlines.


Key Responsibilities

1. Decoding Engineering & Quality Documents:

  • Read and accurately interpret complex Production Drawings, General Arrangement (GA) drawings, and Bill of Materials (BOMs).
  • Thoroughly analyze unpriced purchase orders, Technical data sheets, Quality Assurance Plans (QAP) and Inspection & Test Plans (ITP)

2. Granular Level 4 Scheduling:

  • Break down high-level project milestones into day-by-day shop-floor activities based on the specific manufacturing method required. Refer examples below :
    • Metal Fabrication: Material Marking Cutting/Beveling Fit-up Root Run Back-chipping Final Weld NDT
    • Equipment integration : Engineering Procurement Fabrication Assembly Testing Packing Dispatch

3. Applying Project Management Basics:

  • Build logical schedules using Critical Path Method (CPM), ensuring correct use of Predecessors and Successors (Finish-to-Start, Start-to-Start).
  • Clearly separate "Document Submission" from "Approval", and "PO Placement" from "Material Receipt & QC" for engineering and procurement phases.
  • Identify and use parallel work opportunities to shorten project timelines by running suitable manufacturing steps together. For example ,while machining of components is ongoing, the team can start surface-treatment planning and book painting slots in advance

4. Expediting & Risk Mitigation:

  • Audit vendor-submitted schedules to identify missing steps, "false dependencies," or unrealistic cycle times.
  • Track planned vs. actual progress across multiple vendors and flag risks early (e.g., "The casting is delayed by 3 days, which will push the CNC machining start date").
  • Logically persuade and negotiate with vendors to crash schedules, adopt parallel processing, and commit to recovery plans when projects slipall while maintaining healthy B2B relationships.

Required Skills & Competencies

Technical Knowledge:

  • Manufacturing Processes: Deep, practical understanding of heavy metal fabrication, Machining, assemblies, castings, Forgings and other manufacturing methodologies and their typical constraints.
  • Production methods: Exposure to batch production & one-off production methods.
  • Drawing & GD&T Expertise: High proficiency in reading mechanical production drawings, weld symbols, and interpreting GD&T symbols (Flatness, Concentricity, True Position, Runout) to gauge manufacturing difficulty and time.
  • Project Management Basics: Clear understanding of lead/lag times, critical path identification,dependencies and baseline vs. actual tracking.
  • Testing & Compliance: Familiarity with standard NDT methods (RT, UT, PT, MT) and Material Test Certificates (MTCs).
  • Data center exposure: Experience with data center construction and equipment such as substations, fan wall units, Air handling units is an added advantage

Software Proficiency:

  • Scheduling Tools: Hands-on experience with MS Project (MSP) or Primavera P6 or any other similar PM software
  • Data Handling: Strong Excel / Google sheet skills for managing large BOMs and project data.
  • New age softwares and AI tools: Proactive adoption of new-age softwares and AI tools to drive faster, more efficient workflows.

Behavioral Traits:

  • Hyper-Granular Thinking: The ability to visualize the step-by-step physical transformation of raw material into a finished product.
  • Assertive Communication: Confidence to question a vendors logic (e.g., "Why can't you start fabrication of 2nd batch of transformer cores while the 1st batch of transformers is waiting for client inspection? What is stopping you from keeping those sub-assemblies ready?")
  • Communication & Collaboration : You will collaborate (both in person and virtually) with other members in CoE, product, business, client, vendors, interns etc. and hence will be responsible to drive business outcome across multiple stakeholders.

Preferred Background

  • Education: B.E. / B.Tech in Mechanical, Electrical, Production, or Industrial Engineering.
  • Experience: 5 to 7 years of hands-on experience in Manufacturing Engineering, design engineering, Production Planning at an industrial machinery, data center equipment, EPC, or heavy engineering manufacturer in India.

descriptionFromApi:
Artificial Intelligence (AI) and digital health technologies are transforming healthcare by enabling innovative solutions that enhance health system efficiency, service delivery, and patient outcomes, contributing to the achievement of Universal Health Coverage (UHC) and the health-related Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs).

The Government of Chhattisgarh has formally requested technical support to develop and implement a roadmap for UHC and health-related SDGs in the state. This collaboration was advanced through the Joint Consultative Meeting for the Development and Implementation of UHC and Health SDG Roadmaps in Chhattisgarh and Madhya Pradesh (Bhopal, April 2026) and the Swasth Chhattisgarh Consultation (Raipur, June 2026). Digital health and AI constitute a cross-cutting enabler of the state's UHC acceleration agenda, with implementation to be intensified in designated beacon districts alongside statewide efforts.

As part of this agenda, the Government of Chhattisgarh on the state's digital health action plan, the evaluation of AI tools in health including SAKSHAMA and other AI applications proposed to be taken forward for evaluation in the state — and the scale-up of digital health innovations. Intelehealth is supporting the Government of Chhattisgarh in operationalizing telemedicine, digital health, and AI interventions in the state, including under an Agreement for Performance of Work (APW).

The Senior Digital Health & AI Project Coordinator will be Intelehealth's dedicated in-state resource, based in Raipur, to coordinate digital health and AI interventions across Chhattisgarh — including AI evaluations and digital health innovations — working in close collaboration with Digital Health team and the Department of Health and Family Welfare, Government of Chhattisgarh.

Under the supervision of the designated lead at Intelehealth and in close collaboration with the Digital Health team, the Senior Digital Health & AI Project Coordinator will undertake the following responsibilities:

  • Serve as the state-level project coordinator for digital health and AI interventions supported by Intelehealth in Chhattisgarh, at the state level and in the designated beacon districts, under the state's UHC and health-SDG acceleration agenda.
  • Support the Government of Chhattisgarh in the development, refinement, and implementation of the state's Digital Health and AI roadmap/action plan, ensuring alignment with the Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABDM), national digital health standards (including HL7 FHIR) guidance.
  • Coordinate the design, protocol development, ethics and regulatory processes, field operations, and reporting of AI evaluations in the state — including the evaluation of SAKSHAMA and other AI tools taken forward for evaluation in Chhattisgarh — in collaboration with government counterparts, evaluation partners, academic institutions, and funders.
  • Coordinate the implementation and scale-up of digital health innovations in the state, including telemedicine (hub-and-spoke models and eSanjeevani last-mile strengthening), AI-enabled screening and decision-support tools, and digital platforms for maternal and child health, communicable diseases, and NCDs.
  • Support the operationalisation of digital health and AI activities under the Intelehealth workplans, including readiness assessments, capacity building of frontline health workers and medical officers, and support to the NHM Programme Management Unit.
  • Provide expert technical advice to the Department of Health and Family Welfare, NHM, and State Health Systems Resource Centre on program objectives, execution options, and implementation plans for digital health and AI.
  • Support the framing and application of context-appropriate frameworks by which AI models are evaluated for accuracy, safety, usability, equity, and cost-effectiveness, and the pathways by which promising AI applications transition from proofs-of-concept to scaled, sustainable deployments in the state.
  • Establish and maintain monitoring mechanisms, dashboards, and progress reports to track digital health and AI implementation in the state and beacon districts, and its contribution to health outcomes and equity.
  • Facilitate coordination across stakeholders — state government, technology partners, evaluation partners, academic institutions, and funders — including organising review meetings, workshops, and field visits.
  • Develop and deliver training programs, workshops, and capacity-building initiatives to enhance digital health and AI literacy among state and district health officials and frontline workers.

Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for both code and model artifacts using tools like GitLab CI/CD, GitHub Actions, or Cloud Build

Monitor system performance, cost efficiency, accuracy, and ethical compliance; iterate on model evaluation metrics accordingly

Mentor junior engineers on Python best practices, software design principles, and Generative AI methodologies

Bachelors or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline

Minimum 7 years of professional experience in Python software development

Strong expertise in REST API design and development with FastAPI, Flask, or Django REST Framework

Extensive experience using Jupyter notebooks for data exploration, prototyping, and model training

Proficient with core machine learning libraries such as scikit-learn, TensorFlow, or PyTorch

Demonstrated experience in prompt engineering and working with multiple large language model providers

Solid understanding of vector embeddings, similarity search, and retrieval-augmented generation architectures

Hands-on experience with Docker containerization and orchestration platforms like Kubernetes, Cloud Run, or ECS

Proven track record in productionizing ML/AI systems including logging, tracing, metrics, and automated rollback mechanisms

Job Title:

Position Summary:

We are looking for a seasoned AI Governance professional with proven experience in leading and managing enterprise-wide AI governance frameworks.

This individual will be responsible for defining, implementing, and overseeing governance policies that ensure ethical, compliant, and responsible use of AI across the organization.

The ideal candidate will drive the strategy to align AI initiatives with internal standards, regulatory requirements, and societal expectations.

AI Policy & Framework Development:

  • Implement organizational AI governance policies and risk management frameworks.
  • Align internal governance practices with global standards and regulations (e.g., EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001).
  • Collaborate with legal, compliance, data science, and product teams to ensure AI systems meet ethical and regulatory requirements.

  • Conduct AI risk and impact assessments across the model lifecycle.
  • Monitor compliance with emerging AI regulations, data privacy laws (e.g., GDPR), and sector-specific requirements.
  • Identify and escalate potential ethical, legal, or reputational risks.

Ethical AI & Responsible Innovation:

  • Promote fairness, transparency, accountability, explainability, and human oversight in AI/ML systems.
  • Support initiatives for bias detection, algorithmic accountability, and model interpretability.

Governance Operations & Tooling:

  • Work with cross-functional teams to embed governance controls into MLOps and AI development pipelines.
  • Evaluate or develop tools to support model documentation (e.g., model cards, datasheets), audit trails, and explainability.

Stakeholder Engagement & Training:

  • Act as a subject-matter expert on AI governance for internal and external stakeholders.
  • Design and deliver training programs on responsible AI practices for technical and business teams.

Education:

  • Bachelors or Master’s degree in Law, Computer Science, Data Science, Ethics, Public Policy, or a related field.
  • Additional certifications (e.g., in AI Ethics, Data Protection, Risk Management) are a plus.

  • Experience with responsible AI frameworks, audit processes, or regulatory readiness preferred.

  • Deep understanding of AI/ML technologies and their societal and organizational impacts.
  • Experience working in regulated industries (e.g., finance, healthcare, energy).
  • Knowledge of cybersecurity, data governance, or digital ethics.
  • Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

jobDescription:
We are looking for an experienced Automation Specialist to lead initiatives that improve end-user computing operations and enhance user experience through intelligent automation.

The ideal candidate will have hands-on expertise in Generative AI (GenAI) and Agentic AI, and a strong background in scripting, infrastructure automation, and workflow orchestration.

GenAI & Agentic AI Automation
• Design and implement agentic AI workflows that autonomously manage provisioning, compliance, and remediation tasks.
• Deploy GenAI-powered virtual agents to support ticket triage, contextual help, and predictive issue resolution.
• Use AI-driven telemetry and analytics to monitor user experience and trigger automated responses.
• Integrate GenAI tools into EUC platforms to improve self-service and reduce manual workload.
Automation & Scripting
• Develop PowerShell and Python scripts to automate provisioning, patching, and reporting.
• Use Terraform to define and manage infrastructure-as-code for hybrid and cloud environments.
• Maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions and other DevOps tools.
Workflow Orchestration
• Build business process automation using Power Automate and Microsoft 365 tools.
• Integrate platforms such as ServiceNow, Teams, and Intune to streamline workflows and notifications.
Monitoring & Optimization
• Track system performance and user experience metrics.
• Identify automation opportunities and lead continuous improvement initiatives.

Documentation & Enablement
• Create technical documentation, SOPs, and user guides.
• Train IT staff and end users on new tools, workflows, and AI capabilities.

Essential Skills:
• Experience with GenAI platforms (e.g., Azure OpenAI, Copilot Studio, or similar)
• Hands-on knowledge of agentic AI design and orchestration
• Strong scripting skills in PowerShell, Python, and Terraform
• Familiarity with GitHub Actions, CI/CD pipelines, and DevOps practices
• Proficiency in Microsoft 365, Intune, Azure, and Active Directory
• Strong troubleshooting, communication, and documentation skills

Desirable Skills:
• Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Fundamentals
• OpenAI Developer Certification or equivalent
• Agentic AI Automation Specialist certification
• Microsoft Certified: Modern Desktop Administrator
• HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate
• Experience with ServiceNow and endpoint management tools
• Understanding of Agile and ITIL frameworks

Job Title: LLMOps Engineer GenAI Platforms

Minimum: 3 years of relevant experience

  • Strong MLOps experience
  • Hands-on with LLMs for at least 2 years OR
  • Transitioned from MLOps to LLMOps with understanding of LLM lifecycle

About the Role:

We are looking for a forward-thinking LLMOps Engineer to join our team and help build the next generation of secure, scalable, and responsible Generative AI (GenAI) platforms. This role will focus on establishing governance, security, and operational best practices while enabling development teams to build high-performing GenAI applications. You will also work closely with GenAI agents and integrate LLMs from multiple providers to support diverse use cases.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Design and implement governance frameworks for GenAI platforms, ensuring compliance with internal policies and external regulations (e.g., GDPR, AI Act).
  • Define and enforce responsible AI practices including fairness, transparency, explainability, and auditability.
  • Implement robust security protocols including IAM, data encryption, secure API access, and model sandboxing.
  • Collaborate with security teams to conduct risk assessments and ensure secure deployment of LLMs.
  • Build and maintain scalable LLMOps pipelines for model training, fine-tuning, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring.
  • Automate model lifecycle management with CI/CD, versioning, rollback, and observability.
  • Develop and manage GenAI agents capable of reasoning, planning, and tool use.
  • Integrate and orchestrate LLMs from multiple providers (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic, Cohere, Google, Azure OpenAI) to support hybrid and fallback strategies.
  • Optimize prompt engineering, context management, and agent memory for production use.
  • Ensure high availability, low latency, and cost-efficiency of GenAI workloads across cloud and hybrid environments.
  • Implement monitoring and alerting for model drift, hallucinations, and performance degradation.
  • Partner with GenAI developers to embed best practices and reusable components (SDKs, templates, APIs).
  • Provide technical guidance and documentation to accelerate development and ensure platform consistency.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
  • 4+ years of experience in MLOps, DevOps, or platform engineering, with 1–2 years in LLM/GenAI environments.
  • Deep understanding of LLMs, GenAI agents, prompt engineering, and inference optimization.
  • Experience with LangChain, LlamaIndex, Langraph or similar agent frameworks.
  • Hands-on with MLflow, or equivalent tools.
  • Proficient in Python, containerization (Docker) and cloud platforms (AWS/GCP/Azure).
  • Familiarity with AI governance frameworks and responsible AI principles.
  • Experience with vector databases (e.g., FAISS, Pinecone), RAG pipelines, and model evaluation frameworks.
  • Knowledge of Responsible AI, red-teaming, and OWASP security priciples.

title: Ai Ml Engineer
jobDescription:
Proficient knowledge in Engineering Mathematics Background,along with basic knowledge of Python and C programming

Preferred / Good to Have: .

Experience: 4+ years total,with at least 3+ years relevant in AI / ML domain.

Experience with at least one major AI / ML framework (PyTorch / TensorFlow)
descriptionFromApi:
Position: Senior Software Engineer
We are seeking an experienced AI/ML Engineer with a strong academic and research foundation to contribute to the design, development, and implementation of advanced machine learning and deep learning solutions. The role requires expertise in state-of-the-art architectures, model optimization, and problem-solving applied to real-world scenarios. Proficient knowledge in Engineering Mathematics Background, along with basic knowledge of Python and C programming.

Qualifications
Mandatory:

  • M.Tech in AI/ML with background in Electronics & Communication (EC) or Computer Science (CS).
  • Experience: 4+ years total, with at least 3+ years relevant in AI/ML domain.

Core Skillset (Must-Have):

  • Expertise in Deep Learning architectures: CNN, RNN, GNN, Transformers.
  • Strong programming skills in Python.
  • Experience with at least one major AI/ML framework (PyTorch / TensorFlow).
  • Track record in Computer Vision, Time-Series Analysis, Video Analysis.
  • Familiarity with Unsupervised & Semi-supervised learning techniques.

Preferred/Good to Have:

  • Image Processing, NLP, Edge/Embedded AI deployment
  • Design and develop cutting-edge AI/ML models for vision, time-series, and multimodal data.
  • Research and prototype advanced algorithms using state-of-the-art methods in deep learning.
  • Optimize models for performance and scalability across platforms.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams on real-world product and research applications.
  • Stay ahead of AI/ML trends, and apply them creatively to business challenges.

title: AI Engineer / Lead Engineer
jobDescription:
Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and implement AI/ML models and algorithms.
  • Focus on building Proof of Concept (POC) applications to demonstrate the feasibility and value of AI solutions.
  • Write clean, efficient, and well-documented code.
  • Collaborate with data engineers to ensure data quality and availability for model training and evaluation.
  • Work closely with senior team members to understand project requirements and contribute to technical solutions.
  • Troubleshoot and debug AI/ML models and applications.
  • Stay up-to-date with the latest advancements in AI/ML.
  • Utilize machine learning frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn) to develop and deploy models.
  • Develop and deploy AI solutions on Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
  • Implement data preprocessing and feature engineering techniques using libraries like Pandas and NumPy.
  • Utilize Vertex AI for model training, deployment, and management.
  • Integrate and leverage Google Gemini for specific AI functionalities.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field.
  • 4+ years of experience in developing and implementing AI/ML models.
  • Strong programming skills in Python.
  • Experience with machine learning frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, or Scikit-learn.
  • Good understanding of machine learning concepts and techniques.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
  • Strong problem-solving skills.
  • Good communication skills.
  • Experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) is preferred.
  • Familiarity with Vertex AI is a plus.

descriptionFromApi:
Job Title: Strategic Account Manager (Retail AI / CPG)

Location: Remote

Role Type: Full-Time

Job Summary

The main responsibility of this Account Manager is to build strong relationships with senior stakeholders at each account and own those relationships commercially. You will align with the client on success criteria for each phase and pull the right resources from across ParallelDots (Project Management, Data Science, Product) to deliver against them. You will not rely on a dedicated data analyst to find your pitch; as an AI-native operator, you will autonomously leverage data to build business cases for expansion.

Key Responsibilities

  • Commercial Ownership Global Expansion
    • Own renewal, expansion, and cross-sell targets for your accounts, maintaining accurate forecasting.
    • Define account plans that sequence expansion (next country, next channel, next KPI) and align them quarterly with leadership.
    • Convert proof of ROI in one market into the business case for the next, particularly driving the expansion from modern trade into traditional trade.
    • Negotiate commercial terms, pricing structures, and contract renewals calmly, holding commercial ground without damaging the relationship.
  • Autonomous Data Analytics Strategic Value Delivery
    • Run Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) framed around delivered business value: ROI, cost savings, and execution KPIs.
    • Independently navigate ParallelDots analytics platforms to mine customer shelf data, identify hidden patterns (e.g., localized compliance gaps), and autonomously build targeted, data-backed business cases for upsells.
  • Relationship Stakeholder Management
    • Build multi-threaded relationships across each account so the partnership is not dependent on a single sponsor.
    • Map each clients organization, decision-making process, and economic buyers by market and business unit.
    • Understand competitive landscape within the account and internal champions of competitors and prove our value against them
    • Work closely with customer success team to ensure client gets value out of ParallelDots solution

Qualifications Ideal Profile

  • 5-10 years of experience owning revenue in enterprise B2B, ideally selling technology into CPG, retail, or field execution.
  • Track record of growing existing accounts, not just managing them.
  • Experience with global/multi-market accounts where one client spans many countries or business units.
  • Technical Translation Skills: Comfortable in technical conversations about AI accuracy, integrations, and data pipelines without needing to be the technical expert.
  • AI-Native Data Fluency: Hands-on experience querying data and using modern BI platforms to extract insights and validate ROI independently.
  • Communication: Clear, frequent communicator across both client executives and internal technical teams.
  • Bachelors degree preferred. MBA or consulting background is a plus, but not required.

Why this role exists
Money and stock are the two areas where a bug is not really a bug - it is a hospitals revenue leaking, or a drug count that does not match what is on the shelf. This role owns both, plus the discipline of getting a release out every sprint.
What you will build
- Tariff engine : multiple rate cards per hospital - cash, corporate, Third Party Administrator (TPA), Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PMJAY) - with package and exclusion rules.
- Charge capture driven by events : an order placed anywhere in the hospital becomes a billable line automatically.
- Billing : outpatient and inpatient billing, cashier and day-close, advances, refunds, credit notes, and Goods and Services Tax (GST) treatment.
- Claims and TPA workflow : pre-authorisation, queries, submission and tracking.
- Pharmacy, stock ledger and procurement : an append-only ledger where every movement is a posting and stock on hand is always derivable.
Responsibilities
- Lead the Revenue and Supply pod - yourself, one backend engineer and one frontend engineer.
- Own the rules test pack: build it from fifty real anonymised bills from the pilot hospital, and treat a failing case as a release blocker.
- Own release discipline - versioning, migrations, rollback plan, release notes.
- Review all code touching money or stock, without exception.
- Work with the Chartered Accountant and GST consultant on statutory correctness in month 4.

- Strong NestJS or an equivalent Node.js framework, with PostgreSQL.
- Has owned a payments, ledger, billing or accounting-like domain in production - you understand why you never update a posted row.
- Event-driven patterns: queues, idempotent consumers, eventual consistency, and the ability to explain it to a finance user.
- Real SQL, including reconciliation queries and reporting under load.
- Has led two or three engineers.
Good to have
- Indian statutory context: GST on healthcare services, Tax Deducted at Source (TDS), e-invoicing.
- Hospital or insurance billing exposure.
- Inventory or warehouse systems.
Your first 90 days
- Month 1 - the tariff data model and the charge-capture event contract agreed and built.
- Month 2 - outpatient billing end to end, with the rules test pack running in continuous integration.
- Month 3 - pharmacy sale and stock ledger live in the demo build.
How we work
Two-week sprints. Trunk-based development with short-lived branches. Code review on every pull request. Database changes only through migrations. Automated tests are mandatory around money, stock and clinical-safety paths.

PostgreSQL / SQL Billing / Payments / Ledger Systems Node.js / NestJS Event-Driven Architecture

jobDescription:
Role & responsibilities


Job Description

Consultant: ATS DevOps & Cloud Engineering – AI Enabled

Experience - 6–8 years

Location-  Pune

Mode- Freelancer

Role Overview

We are looking for a hands-on DevOps / Cloud Engineer responsible for automating software delivery, managing cloud infrastructure, improving application reliability, and implementing secure, scalable cloud-native environments across AWS, Azure and GCP.

The candidate should have strong hands-on expertise in CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, containers, Kubernetes, cloud services, monitoring and DevSecOps, along with practical experience using AI/GenAI tools to improve DevOps automation, troubleshooting and engineering productivity.

Required Skills

Must Have

  • 6–8 years of hands-on DevOps / Cloud experience 
  • Strong experience in one major cloud – AWS / Azure / GCP 
  • Working knowledge of at least one additional cloud 
  • Strong CI/CD experience 
  • Terraform / Infrastructure as Code 
  • Docker 
  • Kubernetes 
  • Git / Git-based workflows 
  • Linux 
  • Scripting – Python / Bash / PowerShell 
  • Monitoring, logging and troubleshooting 
  • Strong understanding of networking fundamentals 
  • Security fundamentals / DevSecOps 

AI – Must Have

  • Practical experience using AI coding/productivity tools 
  • Understanding of AI-assisted DevOps automation 
  • Ability to use AI for troubleshooting, scripting and documentation while validating outputs 

Good to Have

  • AWS + Azure + GCP exposure 
  • Helm 
  • Argo CD / GitOps 
  • Prometheus / Grafana / OpenTelemetry 
  • Datadog 
  • Backstage / IDP 
  • Ansible 
  • Vault / secrets management 
  • FinOps / cloud cost optimization 
  • AI agents / Agentic AI 
  • MCP 
  • MLOps / AI workload deployment

Key Responsibilities

DevOps & CI/CD

  • Design, implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines using tools such as GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Jenkins or GitLab CI. 
  • Automate build, test, deployment and release processes. 
  • Implement branching, release and deployment strategies including blue-green, canary and rolling deployments. 
  • Improve deployment reliability, speed and repeatability. 

Multi-Cloud Engineering

  • Work hands-on with AWS, Azure and/or GCP cloud environments. 
  • Provision and manage cloud infrastructure including compute, networking, storage, IAM and managed services. 
  • Understand equivalent services across cloud platforms and recommend appropriate solutions based on workload requirements. 
  • Support cloud migration, modernization and cost optimization initiatives. 

Important: one cloud experience is mandatory + working exposure to other cloud rather than deep expertise in all three.

Infrastructure as Code & Automation

  • Develop reusable infrastructure using Terraform or equivalent IaC tools. 
  • Automate infrastructure provisioning, configuration and environment management. 
  • Implement infrastructure standards, reusable modules and automated policy controls. 
  • Maintain version-controlled infrastructure and configuration. 

Containers & Kubernetes

  • Build and manage Docker containers and containerized applications. 
  • Work with Kubernetes / EKS / AKS / GKE environments. 
  • Support deployments, scaling, configuration, secrets and troubleshooting. 
  • Exposure to Helm, GitOps and tools such as Argo CD is preferred. 

DevSecOps

  • Integrate security into CI/CD and infrastructure workflows. 
  • Implement: 

oSAST 

oDAST 

odependency scanning 

ocontainer/image scanning 

osecrets detection 

  • Follow secure cloud/IAM practices and support vulnerability remediation. 

Observability & SRE

  • Implement application and infrastructure monitoring, logging and alerting. 
  • Work with tools such as CloudWatch, Azure Monitor, GCP Operations Suite, Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog or OpenTelemetry. 
  • Support incident investigation, root-cause analysis and performance troubleshooting. 
  • Contribute to reliability, availability and operational excellence. 


AI / GenAI Expectations

AI-Assisted DevOps

  • Use AI tools such as GitHub Copilot, Amazon Q, Gemini, Claude or ChatGPT to improve: 

oInfrastructure scripting 

oYAML/pipeline development 

oTerraform generation/review 

otroubleshooting 

olog analysis 

odocumentation 

otest automation 

  • Demonstrate ability to validate and secure AI-generated code/configuration rather than blindly accepting it. 

AI is increasingly being incorporated into DevOps workflows for planning, coding, code review, security and operational troubleshooting. 

AI / Agentic DevOps – Good to Have

  • Exposure to AI agents / Agentic AI for IT operations. 
  • Understanding of how AI can support: 

oincident triage 

oroot-cause analysis 

oautomated remediation 

odeployment analysis 

ocloud resource optimization 

oinfrastructure monitoring 

  • Exposure to MCP (Model Context Protocol) or AI-agent integration with DevOps tools is a plus. 

AWS, for example, now provides AI-powered DevOps capabilities that can query infrastructure, metrics, alarms, deployments and incident patterns using natural language. 

Platform Engineering – Preferred

For stronger ATS-level candidates:

  • Understanding of Platform Engineering / Internal Developer Platforms (IDP). 
  • Build reusable "Golden Paths" for development and deployment. 
  • Automate environment provisioning and developer self-service. 
  • Exposure to Backstage or similar developer portals is a plus. 

Platform engineering is increasingly being positioned as the layer that provides reusable, self-service infrastructure, CI/CD and deployment capabilities to development teams.
